purpose: A/B test log for ONE transformer (dark-beast-dbzit9, zimage pipeline, 4-bit). Each line is one generation variant: the exact params used, timings, memory, and a 6-dim Qwen3-VL score. Goal: find sampling-parameter quality levers.
produced_by: manual — run.py image t2i --pipeline zimage --transformer dark-beast-dbzit9 generates the image; run.py caption --style score (qwen3-vl-4b) produces the vlm block; a human assembles each line. No committed writer/reader yet (kb_version / kb.jsonl are unreferenced in python/, bun/, .claude/, scripts/).
consumed_by: human review. Future: a kb reader / dashboard could parse this for cross-model lever comparison.

record_schema.name: kb_version
record_schema.desc: record schema version (migration key). Legacy name; canonical going forward is schema_version.

record_schema.name: test_id
record_schema.desc: <model>-<prompttag>-<group><variant>, e.g. dbzit9-goth-A1. Stable id for cross-referencing.

record_schema.name: prompt
record_schema.desc: {file, sha256_12, summary} — sha256_12 is the reproducibility hash of the EXACT prompt text.

record_schema.name: ab_test
record_schema.desc: {name, group, group_name, lever, variant_tag, variant_label, control}. group=A/B/C; lever=the single parameter varied.

record_schema.name: params
record_schema.desc: CLI params actually used: steps, seed, width, height, resolution, seed_variance + seed_variance_percent/strength/switchover, skin_contrast, noise_clean, cfg_scale. NOTE: zimage pipeline has NO classifier-free guidance, so cfg_scale is null/unused.

record_schema.name: vlm
record_schema.desc: qwen3-vl-4b verdict: {model, overall, detail, sharpness, composition, prompt_adherence, artifacts (1-10 each), issues[], summary}.

record_schema.name: output
record_schema.desc: {image: absolute path to the generated PNG}.

findings: Sampling parameters do NOT fix this model's dominant defect. All 7 variants score artifacts=8 — the issue is PLASTICKY / WAXY / OVERSMOOTHED SKIN (no pores, waxy face/neck/shoulders). Group A (steps 9→12→16→20): overall stays flat at 4 — more steps only make it slower (12s→31s), not better. Group B (seed 123/777): only B2/seed123 nudges overall 4→5 (marginal). Group C (seed_variance on): overall DROPS to 3 and adds a hand-fusion defect. Conclusion: the lever is NOT sampling params — it is a skin-detail LoRA or relaxing the quality gate. This independently confirms memory zimage-moody-plasticky-skin-base-not-lora (plasticky skin is an MLX-platform trait, not LoRA/param-tunable).
notes: This is a DIFFERENT artifact from .claude/workflows/*.knowledge.jsonl (distilled workflow-knowledge records loaded by loadKnowledge/extractKnowledge). That is curated patterns/levers; this is raw per-run measurements. The two share only the JSONL+manifest convention. Not yet git-tracked.
